item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 10 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 10 #SLPRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at 11:00 PM 18 August 2026

Yellow Warning: #OrientalMindoro
Associated Hazard: FLOODING in low lying areas and near river channels.

Meanwhile, Moderate to occasionally heavy rains are expected over #Sorsogon(Gubat, Irosin, Matnog, SantaMagdalena, Bulusan, Barcelona), #Catanduanes, #Masbate(Mandaon, Milagros, CityOfMasbate, SanFernando, Batuan, Mobo, SanPascual), #Albay(PioDuran, Guinobatan, CityOfLigao, CityOfTabaco, Malilipot, Malinao, Polangui, Oas and Libon) within the next 2 to 3 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Romblon, #Masbate(Aroroy, Monreal, Claveria, Baleno, SanJacinto), #Sorsogon(Donsol, Pilar, Castilla, CityOfSorsogon, PrietoDiaz, Casiguran, Juban, Magallanes, Bulan), #Albay(Jovellar, Camalig, Daraga, LegazpiCity, SantoDomingo, Bacacay, RapuRapu and Manito) which may persist within 2 to 3 hours.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 02:00 AM Tomorrow.
